ai_extraction_decisions_value_check.name: ai_extraction_decisions_value_check
ai_extraction_decisions_value_check.value: ("ai_extraction_field_decisions"."decision" = 'rejected' and "ai_extraction_field_decisions"."accepted_value" is null) or ("ai_extraction_field_decisions"."decision" in ('accepted', 'corrected') and "ai_extraction_field_decisions"."accepted_value" is not null)

ai_extraction_spans_offset_check.name: ai_extraction_spans_offset_check
ai_extraction_spans_offset_check.value: num_nonnulls("ai_extraction_source_spans"."start_offset", "ai_extraction_source_spans"."end_offset") in (0, 2) and ("ai_extraction_source_spans"."start_offset" is null or ("ai_extraction_source_spans"."start_offset" >= 0 and "ai_extraction_source_spans"."end_offset" > "ai_extraction_source_spans"."start_offset"))

document_external_shares_revocation_chec.name: document_external_shares_revocation_check
document_external_shares_revocation_chec.value: ("document_external_shares"."status" = 'revoked') = ("document_external_shares"."revoked_at" is not null and "document_external_shares"."revoked_by" is not null)

readiness_provider_referrals_mode_check.name: readiness_provider_referrals_mode_check
readiness_provider_referrals_mode_check.value:
("readiness_provider_referrals"."request_mode" = 'support_request' and "readiness_provider_referrals"."governance_evidence_reference" is null and "readiness_provider_referrals"."matched_provider_id" is null)
    or ("readiness_provider_referrals"."request_mode" = 'governed_referral' and "readiness_provider_referrals"."governance_evidence_reference" is not null)

regulatory_lane_impacts_ack_check.name: regulatory_lane_impacts_ack_check
regulatory_lane_impacts_ack_check.value: ("regulatory_rule_lane_impacts"."state" <> 'acknowledged') or ("regulatory_rule_lane_impacts"."acknowledged_by" is not null and "regulatory_rule_lane_impacts"."acknowledged_at" is not null)

regulatory_lane_impacts_resolve_check.name: regulatory_lane_impacts_resolve_check
regulatory_lane_impacts_resolve_check.value: ("regulatory_rule_lane_impacts"."state" <> 'resolved') or ("regulatory_rule_lane_impacts"."resolved_by" is not null and "regulatory_rule_lane_impacts"."resolved_at" is not null)

staff_access_break_glass_check.name: staff_access_break_glass_check
staff_access_break_glass_check.value: not "staff_access_grants"."break_glass" or ("staff_access_grants"."second_approved_by" is not null and "staff_access_grants"."alerted_at" is not null)
